subject: ophthalmology
title: Corneal degenerations, dystrophies and ectasias

steps.tx: **Keratoconus** thins central cornea into a cone after puberty (bilateral but asymmetric, vernal allergy and Down syndrome with eye rubbing associations): progressive myopic astigmatism uncorrectable by glasses, scissors reflex on retinoscopy, Munson sign (lower lid bulge on downgaze), Vogt striae, Fleischer iron ring and apical scarring. Topography diagnoses early cones; **corneal crosslinking** halts progression, rigid gas permeable or scleral lenses rehabilitate vision, and acute hydrops (Descemet tear with sudden stromal oedema) needs hyperosmotics then DALK or penetrating graft for scars.
steps.say: Teen with worsening astigmatism glasses cannot fix: map the cornea. Cone plus iron ring is keratoconus; crosslink early.

steps.tx: Endothelial failure clouds mornings: **Fuchs dystrophy** (guttae, Descemet thickening, morning blur clearing later) progresses to bullous keratopathy with painful ruptured bullae, treated by hypertonic saline, bandage lenses and endothelial keratoplasty (DSEK or DMEK). **Pseudophakic bullous keratopathy** follows complicated cataract surgery similarly. **Arcus senilis** (peripheral lipid ring with clear interval) is ageing physiology, but arcus before forty hunts hyperlipidaemia; **band keratopathy** calcifies interpalpebral Bowman in chronic uveitis or hypercalcaemia, removed by chelation (EDTA).
steps.say: Morning blur clearing by noon is Fuchs endothelium failing. Arcus young means lipids; band calcium means chronic uveitis or calcium excess.

steps.tx: Stromal dystrophies deposit bilaterally and symmetrically: granular (bread crumb deposits), macular (cloudy with Descemet involvement, autosomal recessive), lattice (refractile lines with recurrent erosions and amyloid). **Salzmann nodular degeneration** raises bluish nodules after chronic surface disease. **Terrien marginal degeneration** thins superior periphery with against the rule astigmatism. Keratoglobus balloons the whole cornea from birth (brittle, rupture prone). Phototherapeutic keratectomy smooths superficial dystrophies; deeper disease grafts.
steps.say: Bilateral symmetric deposits are dystrophies; lattice lines bleed into erosions. Nodular Salzmann follows chronic surface inflammation.

steps.tx: Limbal stem cell failure (chemical burns, Stevens Johnson, aniridia) conjunctivalises cornea with vessels and persistent defects, needing amniotic membrane or stem cell transplantation rather than standard grafts which fail. **Pterygium** recurrence prevention uses conjunctival autografting; bare sclera techniques recur. Corneal tattooing and prosthetic (keratoprosthesis) options serve blind opaque corneas unsuitable for grafts. Kayser Fleischer rings (Descemet copper) flag Wilson disease in young patients with movement disorders, distinct from Fleischer iron rings of keratoconus.
steps.say: Vessels marching over cornea after burns means stem cells died: grafts fail without them. Copper ring plus tremor is Wilson.
